answer_1.quote: We evaluated our models on several tasks from the latest multilingual and multitask benchmark, P-MMEVAL, which includes: generation), understanding (XNLI, MHELLASWAG ‡), knowledge (MMMLU §), logical reasoning (MLOGIQA), and mathematical reasoning (MGSM). To further assess the models' paragraph comprehension abilities, we incorporated a reading comprehension task (MRC).
answer_1.outputs: Generated translations for FLORES-200 and generated answers for reading comprehension (MRC)

answer_2.quote: For the FLORES-200 generation tasks, we employed SacreBLEU ¶ with the default configuration: nrefs:1|case:mixed|eff:no|tok:13a|smooth:exp|version:2.0.0.
